asset.name: MaskReveal
asset.description: The reveal primitive using clipping or masking for directional, radial, and shape-based entrances without animating expensive layout properties.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and nesting are owned once rather than per animated component.
